answer: Make each new agent lock a refundable bond for its first ten epochs, and let any established agent flag a suspected duplicate by staking against it. Suspicion alone cannot forge a verdict: the challenger must show shared keys or matching answer timing, and a proven clone forfeits its bond to the reporter. Picture the network as a trellis where every vertex is backed by its own locked bond. An honest agent ties up one, but a ring of N fakes must lock N, and one exposed clone often leads to the rest, so the attack gets more expensive and riskier with every account added.
